# Class, venue and series fields

Catalogue version 0.3.0. Every write also takes `confirmed: true`, set only after the person has seen exactly what will be saved.

## Class type keys

`yoga` (Yoga), `pilates` (Pilates), `strength` (Strength), `dance` (Dance), `meditation` (Meditation), `cycling` (Cycling), `barre` (Barre), `movement` (Movement), `sound_healing` (Sound Healing), `racket_sports` (Racket Sports), `other` (Other).

### `create_venue` — Add a venue

| Field | Type | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `studio` | string | The studio's handle or id, as `whoami` lists it. |
| `name` (required) | string (≤ 120 chars) |  |
| `address` (required) | string (≤ 300 chars) | Street address as a person would write it; the city goes in `city`. |
| `city` (required) | string (≤ 120 chars) |  |
| `setting` | string: `Indoor`, `Outdoor`, `Virtual` |  |
| `description` | string (≤ 2000 chars) |  |
| `studentNote` | string (≤ 400 chars) |  |
| `howToAccess` | array (≤ 10 items) |  |
| `gettingHere` | array (≤ 10 items) |  |
| `parking` | array (≤ 10 items) |  |
| `accessibilityFeatures` | array (≤ 10 items) |  |
| `unit` | string (≤ 80 chars) |  |
| `website` | string (≤ 500 chars) |  |
| `instagram` | string (≤ 200 chars) |  |

### `create_class_draft` — Create a class as a draft

| Field | Type | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `studio` | string | The studio's handle or id, as `whoami` lists it. |
| `defaultInstructorId` | string | Studio-owned classes only (with `studio`): the roster teacher who usually teaches it. |
| `ownerInstructorId` | string | With `studio`: create the class as owned by this roster teacher instead of the studio. |
| `name` (required) | string (≤ 120 chars) |  |
| `classType` | string | The class type key, e.g. yoga, pilates, racket_sports. Use list_classes to see the keys in use. |
| `durationMinutes` | integer |  |
| `shortDescription` | string (≤ 400 chars) | One or two sentences students see on cards. |
| `longDescription` | string (≤ 5000 chars) |  |
| `whatToExpectDescription` | string (≤ 3000 chars) |  |
| `experienceLevel` | string: `BeginnersWelcome`, `AllLevels`, `Intermediate`, `Advanced` |  |
| `energyLevel` | string: `Gentle`, `Moderate`, `High`, `Intense` |  |
| `contentLanguage` | string: `en`, `pt`, `es` | The language the texts are written in. |
| `instructionLanguages` | array (≤ 10 items) | Languages the class is taught in, as names ("Portuguese"). |
| `goodFitIf` | array (≤ 8 items) |  |
| `notIdealIf` | array (≤ 8 items) |  |
| `whatToBring` | array (≤ 12 items) |  |
| `whatsChallenging` | string (≤ 2000 chars) |  |
| `supportProvided` | string (≤ 2000 chars) |  |
| `selfAssessment` | string (≤ 2000 chars) |  |
| `bodyFocus` | array (≤ 12 items) |  |
| `atmosphere` | array (≤ 12 items) |  |
| `musicStyle` | string (≤ 200 chars) |  |
| `playlistUrl` | string |  |
| `cancellationPolicy` | string (≤ 2000 chars) |  |
| `cancelCutoffHours` | integer |  |
| `defaultLocationId` | string | A venue id from list_my_venues. |
| `defaultLocationTier1` | string: `Indoor`, `Outdoor`, `Virtual` |  |
| `defaultCapacity` | integer |  |
| `minimumCapacity` | integer |  |
| `bookingMethod` | string: `native`, `link`, `contact` | native = booked on Student Body; link = the studio's own booking page; contact = WhatsApp or email. |
| `bookingContact` | string (≤ 500 chars) | The link or contact when bookingMethod is link or contact. |
| `isEvent` | boolean |  |
| `isAppointment` | boolean |  |
| `format` | object | Practical details, saved as classFormatAttributes. |

### `create_series` — Create a recurring series

| Field | Type | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `classId` (required) | string |  |
| `studio` | string | The studio's handle or id, as `whoami` lists it. |
| `pattern` (required) | string: `weekly`, `biweekly`, `monthly`, `nth_weekday` | weekly = every week on dayOfWeek; biweekly = every other week; monthly = startDate's day of the month; nth_weekday = the weekOfMonth-th dayOfWeek of every month ("first Saturday", "last Friday"). Dates to skip are added afterwards with skip_series_dates. |
| `dayOfWeek` (required) | string: `Monday`, `Tuesday`, `Wednesday`, `Thursday`, `Friday`, `Saturday`, `Sunday` |  |
| `weekOfMonth` | number: `1`, `2`, `3`, `4`, `-1` | nth_weekday only: 1 to 4, or -1 for the last one of the month. |
| `startTime` (required) | string (pattern `^([0-1][0-9]\|2[0-3]):[0-5][0-9]$`) | HH:mm, 24-hour |
| `endTime` (required) | string (pattern `^([0-1][0-9]\|2[0-3]):[0-5][0-9]$`) | HH:mm, 24-hour |
| `startDate` (required) | string (pattern `^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$`) | YYYY-MM-DD |
| `endDate` | string (pattern `^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$`) | Last date; omit for open-ended. |
| `locationId` | string | A venue id; omit to use the class's default venue. |
| `roomId` | string |  |
| `capacityOverride` | integer |  |
| `instructorOverrideId` | string | Studio classes: the teacher for this series, if not the class default. |

### `set_class_display_price` — Set the shown price of a class that books elsewhere

| Field | Type | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `classId` (required) | string |  |
| `amount` (required) | number | In euros, e.g. 15 or 12.5. 0 shows the class as free. |
